WITH merchant_captures AS (
    SELECT m.merchant_id, a.currency, CAST(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(c.captured_at_utc, m.settlement_tz) AS DATE) AS local_day, c.amount
    FROM captures AS c
    JOIN authorisations AS a ON a.auth_id = c.auth_id
    JOIN merchants AS m ON m.merchant_id = a.merchant_id
)
SELECT merchant_id, currency, local_day, CAST(SUM(amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS captured
FROM merchant_captures
GROUP BY merchant_id, currency, local_day
rationale: Convert the UTC instant with the merchant's IANA time zone before casting to a date and aggregating.
assumptions: Spark session and JVM use UTC
The canonical fixture contains an IANA zone for every merchant
